Keeper — Archon (Tier IV).

Trade — Read the omens: One divination-grade answer per downtime — a true sign about a chosen course, delivered as an omen, not a sentence. Standard fee 270 marks (Soft Power).

Trick — Intercession (1/scene): An ally under the Keeper's care who would drop to 0 Stress holds at 1; the Keeper visibly carries it for them.
